rows.text: With a strange laughing sound, a nymph appears from the shadows.
Come forth, warrior, pay your respects to the Crrkin' Demon King that rules darkness, and face me!
rows.speaker: Nymph of Dawn

rows.text: Kekee... No wait, crrrkkk... Has the messenger of the prophecy finally arrived after all?
rows.speaker: Nymph of Dawn

rows.text: Answer me this then — in the place extinguished of the fiery sun, on the stage once watched by thousands, how many flames still burn bright?
rows.speaker: Nymph of Dawn

rows.text: Five flames.
Wrong! The answer lies above the stage of glory, crrk.
rows.speaker: Nymph of Dawn

rows.text: Those who do not pay attention to detail should be punished. Return the title of Kremnos Warrior, and begin your training anew as a recruit, crrk!
rows.speaker: Nymph of Dawn

rows.text: You're back from your training? Answer me this then — in the place extinguished of the fiery sun, on the stage once watched by thousands, how many flames still burn bright?
rows.speaker: Nymph of Dawn

rows.text: Thirteen flames.
Yes, you already know the essence of flame... Ah, flame, how long still will it burn, crrk?
rows.speaker: Nymph of Dawn

rows.text: You have proven your strength. No nymph is your equal, I will open the path for you.
rows.speaker: Nymph of Dawn
